sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Ponytail is a single prompt, packaged as a skill and plugin, that makes AI coding agents write less code. The agent first reads the code a change touches, reuses what already exists, and writes only what the task needs.
sixtySeconds.problem: Coding agents often add libraries or hundreds of lines where a few would do, which costs tokens, time and review effort. Ponytail pushes the agent toward the smallest correct change while keeping validation, error handling, security and accessibility.
whoFor: Claude Code and Codex users who find agent output bloated
Developers who want smaller, easier-to-review diffs
Teams that want agent reviews focused on real risks
Anyone trying to cut agent token costs
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it if your agent tends to over-engineer and you want leaner changes with tests kept for risky logic. The author's benchmark reports less code, time, cost and tokens, but results will vary with your codebase.
requirements: Claude Code, Codex, or another agent that can read a rules file or skill

overview: Ponytail is one prompt, skills/ponytail/SKILL.md, with a compact AGENTS.md version for agents that read a rules file. The rest of the repository loads that prompt into different agents. It is active every session once installed, at a lite, full or ultra intensity.

Before choosing a solution the agent reads the code the change touches and traces the real flow, then prefers the simplest option, such as using an existing component or a browser feature over a new library. Logic with branches, loops, parsing, money or security keeps one small test, and each reply ends with what was skipped or not checked.

It adds commands: /ponytail-review reviews the current diff for bugs, security, load, missing tests and code to cut; /ponytail-audit runs the same checks on the whole repo; /ponytail-debt collects deliberate shortcut comments into a ledger. In Claude Code a band above the prompt shows cost, tokens and test status for the current task.

features.title: Smallest correct change
features.body: Reuses existing code and platform features before writing new code.

features.title: Never cuts safety
features.body: Validation, error handling, security and accessibility stay in.

features.title: Senior-style review
features.body: /ponytail-review checks bugs, security, load, missing tests and what to cut.

features.title: Whole-repo audit
features.body: /ponytail-audit maps the code and ranks what to fix first.

features.title: Shortcut ledger
features.body: /ponytail-debt gathers deferred shortcut: comments so they get revisited.

features.title: Cost band
features.body: In Claude Code, shows task cost, tokens, agent time and test status.

strengths: Simple: a single prompt you can read
limitations: Benchmark numbers come from the author's own tests
Opinionated style may not suit every team
The band and board are Claude Code only

useCases.title: Trim an agent's output
useCases.body: Keep it active so features land as small diffs.

install.verificationNote: Commands come from Ponytail's README. AIRepoHub hasn't run them yet.

steps.title: Add the marketplace and plugin
steps.code:
codex plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail
codex plugin add ponytail@ponytail

steps.title: Trust the hooks
steps.body: Open /hooks in Codex, trust its two lifecycle hooks and start a new thread.

steps.title: Copy AGENTS.md into your project
steps.body: Or ask your agent to install skills/ponytail/SKILL.md as a skill. INSTALL.md has steps for Copilot, Cursor, OpenCode and Gemini.

tutorial.title: Review your current change with Ponytail
tutorial.useCase: Get a senior-developer-style review of a diff in Claude Code.
tutorial.expected: A list of findings, each saying what the code does, what can go wrong and how to fix it, most important first.
nextSteps: Set a default level with PONYTAIL_DEFAULT_MODE
Import past sessions into the board with /ponytail band import

troubleshooting.solution: Commands need a skill-capable host. In Codex they're namespaced, for example $ponytail:ponytail-review.

troubleshooting.problem: Not sure a copy is genuine
troubleshooting.solution: Install only from DietrichGebert/ponytail on GitHub or @dietrichgebert/ponytail on npm; it never ships .exe or .dll files.
Lower the level with /ponytail lite, or turn it off with /ponytail off.
